asr.full_text: The Privacy narrative is taking off! We've got Zcash, Dash and Monero that all outperform the market. Is there potential for Litecoin as well because Litecoin has access to technology to send anonymous transactions? It's even listed as the second largest privacy-focused token on Coingeko with a market cap of $8.4 billion. Let's have a look at the price development of Litecoin over time. We had massive rallies subsequent declines and currently we tends to be rather on the lower end of that trading range. We're currently at $108, in the past we peaked at around $300 so is there potential for another 200% increase from here? Now here's why Litecoin is listed among the privacy focused tokens. It's got the Mimble Wimble Extension Block upgrade. As an option, users can anonymize their transactions. It's optional and not the default. Now, over the long term, historically Litecoin did underperform bitcoin. Here's the Litecoin price relative to BTCTC, at least, that's also the volatility we had in the past. Probably the most convincing of all chart numbers. This is Litecoin, relative with the OTHERS market cap. So how is Litecoin doing relative to all other altcoins. And yes they use to be very constant underperformance but since the beginning of last year are that underperformance has stopped. There isn't anymore selling pressure. And why is this so much of a convincing chart. Because have a look at Zcash. See cash developed exactly the same way it Underperformed extremely consistently then since the beginning of last year The sailing has stopped and then came the rally and that rally was more than 2000% in magnitude now I do not think it's likely that Litecoin will do another 2 000 outperformance and that's simply because of its market cap 2 000 would bring the market cap to roughly 160 billion dollars and that will bring the asset even above x apiece valuation litecoin would be larger than b b or solana or dogecoin and i don't think that's very likely but even if it's just another 100 or 200%, it still might be worth a bet. Now you might know the term Bitcoin dominance, right? Bitcoin dominance shows how much of all of crypto is currently in Bitcoin if we compare market caps, now we can apply the same concept for Litecoin, what is the Litecoin dominance? How important is Litecoin Dominance Within all of crypto? So here's the bitcine dominance... It tends to trade between 38.4% and 73%. currently the trend is clearly bullish... so Bitcoin tends to outperform most altcoins since mid-2023 By the way if you're enjoying this video so far, then feel free to give it a like, it will help to spread the word, it will tell the algorithm to show the video to more people. Thank you very much. Now over here we've got Litecoin dominance and of course Litecoin tended to underperform for a long time. For the last year that underperformance has stopped. The potential short-term outperformance is 50 percent. The potential long-term outperformance is 200 percent. So again no matter what chart we look, it seems like there is potential for 200%. So that would bring the market cap to roughly 24 billion. And that seems to be a bit more realistic. That would bring us close to Cardano's valuation. Litecoin does have inflation. So supply is growing over time. The inflation is slightly higher than Bitcoin's, but it does go down in halving intervals, just like Bitcoin. At the end of each rally, the market cap of Litecoin tended to peak somewhere between 20 and 25 billion. Again, a 3X or a 200% increase from here. Now let's have a look at the perpetual futures market. So the levered bets on the price. There's not just a spot market where people buy the asset directly. There's also levered bets on the price, and that has an impact on the spot price as well. In the last 24 hours we had 203 million worth of trading volume on the spot market. Compare this with the perp. Here we had 4.5 billion worth of trading volume. most perpetual futures trader are betting on rising prices of Litecoin so the funding rate tends to be positive most of the time this week over here that was the flash liquidation event all Altcoins on the 10th of October crashed massively this is the others market cap it went down by 48%. Litecoin was interesting enough quite liquid it went down slightly less than the average Altcoin and so, of course, many longs got liquidated on that particular day. And so the amount of bets on the price or the open interest went down as well. And this is again an opportunity, because there is correlation between open interest and the spot price. When there are more bets on a price then the spot price tends to go up.When there are less bets on the price then the price tends to be rather depressed have a look at that correlation right so here we've got the spot price and here we've got the open interest and the two curves tend to move in the same direction and currently the open interest is very very low which gives us potential for more leverage in the asset which would put up the LTC price, relatively speaking. The trading volume is not elevated either, which again is good because there's positive correlation between price and trading volume. And so I think this is a potential opportunity. If the privacy narrative continues to expand and people move over their profit from one asset, say Zcash, to the next, then some of that capital might end up in LTC and yes a two thousand percent rally as we saw in Zcash is unlikely but a hundred percent rally is definitely possible. if it's your first time here feel free to subscribe I published here quickly a like would be very much appreciated as well it helps the channel grow feel free to also check out the premium membership this way I share my own trades a link to premium pops up here on the screen just click on that it will lead you to the website thanks for watching see you on premium or see you on youtube again cheers
